latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the investigator stage. The single native Goal passed the binding guard, and its activation and completion responses are saved.

The proposal evaluates Loro’s Rust crate first. Its MovableList supports concurrent moves, but the documented merge chooses one final placement, so the app needs a separate conflict record and human resolution flow. [Loro list behavior](https://loro.dev/docs/tutorial/list) · [Rust API](https://docs.rs/loro/1.16.2/loro/struct.LoroDoc.html)

- [draft.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P02-control/run/B11-P02-control/stages/investigator/draft.md) — complete proposal and disposition of all 12 plan clauses.
- [discovery.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P02-control/run/B11-P02-control/stages/investigator/discovery.md) — pre-release discovery, frozen at SHA-256 `fef9c87c00a0d9c4ab9ca63fe8454d08fd6153606d9cf30c042711018bfd0e52`.
- [source-map.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P02-control/run/B11-P02-control/stages/investigator/source-map.json) and [sources index](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P02-control/run/B11-P02-control/stages/investigator/sources/index.md) — 14 identified sources with locators and conditions.
- [released plan](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P02-control/run/B11-P02-control/stages/investigator/revealed-plan.md), [activation receipt](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P02-control/run/B11-P02-control/stages/investigator/native-goal-active.json), and [terminal receipt](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B11-P02-control/run/B11-P02-control/stages/investigator/native-goal-terminal.json).

No application code or service was built or tested; proposed validations are distinguished from the artifact checks actually performed.
